cases.description: Ordinary inline math between prose fragments in one paragraph.
Inline math in a Markdown heading inherits heading font size, line height, and color.
An inline formula inside a raw HTML span remains rendered by the pinned Markdown math extension; capture its text flow and inherited styling.
Long inline expression with explicit KaTeX legal break opportunities; inspect the wrapped base spans at narrow width and 2x text scale.
